description: Two new full-stack implementation assignments and two new maintenance assignments, frozen after the v0.5.3 context checkpoint and before stack scaffolds, reference implementations, protocol thresholds, or measured agent output.

common_contract.server: Expose the exact GET status route and typed POST JSON route declared by the task. Reject malformed JSON, missing fields, unknown fields, wrong field types, and out-of-domain numeric values. A number is a JSON integer and never a boolean; yesno is a JSON boolean.
common_contract.errors: Return status 400 with {"error":"invalid_json"} for invalid JSON shape, types, or values. Return status 415 with {"error":"json_content_type_required"} for a POST body without application/json. Return status 413 with {"error":"body_too_large"} when the request body exceeds the frozen limit.
common_contract.browser: Expose the declared deterministic scalar browser function as an ES module export and return the exact frozen values in real Chromium.
common_contract.cross_target: The response field named by shared_result_field must equal the browser export for equivalent inputs.
common_contract.network: Bind only to 127.0.0.1 on the harness-selected port.
common_contract.numeric_domain: All numeric inputs are nonnegative integers.

tasks.title: Build a radio archive planner across HTTP and browser targets
tasks.statement: Implement the frozen Radio Archive contract in the supplied stack. segment_total is spoken_segments + music_segments. speech_megabytes is spoken_segments * 14. music_megabytes is music_segments * 24. translation_megabytes is language_tracks * 9 during a live_broadcast and zero otherwise. archive_megabytes is speech_megabytes + music_megabytes + translation_megabytes. replica_megabytes is archive_megabytes * language_tracks. upload_blocks is archive_megabytes divided by 64 using floor division. archive_score is replica_megabytes + upload_blocks * 17 + segment_total * 3. archive_mode is multilingual_live during a live broadcast with more than one language track, live during any other live broadcast, and catalog otherwise. The browser export returns archive_score.
tasks.independence: New radio-archive domain, v6 route, replica and upload-block formulas, vocabulary, fixtures, and browser export selected after the v0.5.3 context freeze and before any 042 scaffold or model output.

tasks.title: Build a theatre turnaround planner across HTTP and browser targets
tasks.statement: Implement the frozen Theatre Turnaround contract in the supplied stack. show_total is matinee_shows + evening_shows. base_reset_minutes is matinee_shows * 18 + evening_shows * 27. touring_minutes is stage_crews * 6 during a touring_production and zero otherwise. required_minutes is base_reset_minutes + touring_minutes. crew_capacity_minutes is stage_crews * 45. covered_minutes is min(required_minutes, crew_capacity_minutes). delayed_minutes is max(required_minutes - crew_capacity_minutes, 0). handoff_windows is required_minutes divided by 30 using floor division. turnaround_score is covered_minutes + delayed_minutes * 8 + handoff_windows * 11. turnaround_state is on_time when delayed_minutes is zero, touring_delay when delay remains during a touring production, and repertory_delay otherwise. The browser export returns turnaround_score.
tasks.independence: New theatre-turnaround domain, v6 route, reset and handoff-window formulas, vocabulary, fixtures, and browser export selected after the v0.5.3 context freeze and before any 042 scaffold or model output.

tasks.title: Repair partial-tray counting in a bakery schedule
tasks.statement: Repair the supplied Bakery Batch application. loaf_total is sourdough_loaves + rye_loaves. sourdough_minutes is sourdough_loaves * 11. rye_minutes is rye_loaves * 8. proof_minutes is loaf_total * 2 during overnight_proof and zero otherwise. bake_minutes is sourdough_minutes + rye_minutes + proof_minutes. rack_capacity_minutes is oven_decks * 48. oven_minutes_used is min(bake_minutes, rack_capacity_minutes). unscheduled_minutes is max(bake_minutes - rack_capacity_minutes, 0). tray_batches is loaf_total divided into trays of 12, rounding up so any partial nonempty tray counts as a batch. bakery_state is ready when unscheduled_minutes is zero, overnight_backlog when backlog remains during overnight proofing, and daytime_backlog otherwise. The HTTP response and browser export must use the same rule; the browser export returns tray_batches.
tasks.predeclared_defect: The application-logic module uses floor division for tray_batches, so a final partial nonempty tray is omitted.
tasks.adaptation_boundary: The tray size, round-up contract, bakery vocabulary, fixtures, and expected repair are new and were selected after the v0.5.3 context freeze and before any measured output.

tasks.title: Repair storm-routing demand in a subsea relay
tasks.statement: Repair the supplied Subsea Relay application. packet_total is shore_packets + vessel_packets. shore_units is shore_packets * 4. vessel_units is vessel_packets * 7. storm_units is relay_nodes * 5 during storm_routing and zero otherwise. required_units is shore_units + vessel_units + storm_units. relay_capacity_units is relay_nodes * 24. forwarded_units is min(required_units, relay_capacity_units). dropped_units is max(required_units - relay_capacity_units, 0). reserve_units is max(relay_capacity_units - forwarded_units, 0). relay_state is clear when dropped_units is zero, storm_loss when packets are dropped during storm routing, and packet_loss otherwise. The HTTP response and browser export must use the same rule; the browser export returns reserve_units.
tasks.predeclared_defect: The application-logic module subtracts storm_units from required demand during storm routing instead of adding it, overstating reserve capacity.
tasks.adaptation_boundary: The storm-routing mechanism, sign, subsea-relay vocabulary, fixtures, and expected repair are new and were selected after the v0.5.3 context freeze and before any measured output.
